description: We are a multidisciplinary team passionate about space exploration, AI, data science, and software development. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are tackling the Martian Map challenge, using technology and data-driven approaches to explore and visualize Mars. Our team combines technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving to build impactful solutions.
summary:
Areographica is an offline-first, client-side planetary navigation and hazard-assessment platform designed to safeguard Mars surface operations. Addressing the "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map" challenge, Areographica tackles the dangerous 44-minute Earth-Mars communication latency that has historically led to rover sand entrapments and severe wheel punctures across Gale Crater. 

By unifying disparate NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) datasets—including high-resolution MRO CTX optical mosaics, MGS MOLA topographic elevation, and Mars Odyssey THEMIS thermal inertia—into a unified Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) console, the system computes slope-cost-weighted A* pathfinding vectors around steep escarpments and hazardous dune fields. 

Operating seamlessly with zero-server dependency on both desktop workstations and installable mobile PWAs in English and Arabic, Areographica adheres to an "Honest by Design" philosophy: ensuring today's safe rover traverse becomes tomorrow's trusted astronaut path before taking the first step.
details:
1. What it Does & How it Works

Areographica is a high-reliability planetary navigation and exploration console that bridges the gap between raw orbital telemetry and tactical surface navigation.

  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Streams and overlays global Mars orbital layers—Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) Context Camera (CTX) base imagery, Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) MOLA shaded relief/elevation, and Mars Odyssey THEMIS daytime thermal infrared—directly in the browser using NASA Mars Trek WMTS standards.
  • Hazard-Aware A Routing: * Implements a slope-cost pathfinding algorithm that calculates travel impedance over complex Martian topography. Instead of calculating Euclidean distance alone, it penalizes steep slopes, loose regolith, and rugged ventifacts using local digital elevation models.
  • Dual Operational Modes: Features an "Educational & Mission Guide" exploring Curiosity's real drill targets (Yellowknife Bay, Glen Torridon) alongside an interactive "Tactical Route Planner" for custom waypoint navigation across Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp).
  • Client-Side Edge Execution: All routing computations and coordinate transformations run 100% in the user's browser, enabling full functionality in offline, high-latency, or field conditions.

2. Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Mitigating Catastrophic Hardware Loss: Spirit was permanently trapped at "Troy" in 2009, Opportunity lost five weeks at "Purgatory Dune", and Curiosity suffered wheel punctures from sharp "gator-back" ventifacts. Areographica flags these hazards before a drive command is executed.
  • Solving Communication Latency: Because round-trip radio signals between Earth and Mars take up to 44 minutes, operators and future astronauts cannot wait for Earth-in-the-loop decisions during tactical traverses.
  • From Robotic Rover to Human Crew: By validating safe traverse corridors today against 14+ years of robotic rover logs, Areographica lays the foundational spatial infrastructure for crewed Artemis-to-Mars surface excursions.
  • Inclusive Scientific Outreach: With full Arabic (RTL) and English bilingual localization, the platform democratizes access to NASA planetary science for international researchers and Arab youth.

3. Tools, Coding Languages & Technologies

  • Frontend & Core Engine: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet.js, Proj4js (Martian sinusoidal projection conversions).
  • Mobile Architecture: Progressive Web App (PWA) with Service Workers, Web App Manifest, offline caching, and responsive touch-first UI.
  • Data Pipeline & Processing: NASA Solar System Treks WMTS REST APIs, GDAL / QGIS for spatial reprojection, Python PDS data scrapers.
  • Hosting & Version Control: GitHub, GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

4. Creativity & Innovation

  • Actionable "Walk Here, Not There" Intelligence: While existing planetary tools (like JMARS or Google Mars) serve as static data viewers, Areographica transforms fragmented raw data into tactical, traversal-ready safety vectors.
  • "Honest by Design" Transparency: In compliance with aerospace ethics, Areographica never falsely certifies a path as "100% safe." It explicitly displays sensor resolution limits, potential unseen sub-meter obstacles, and algorithm uncertainty to operators.
  • Dual-Platform Companion: Instant QR-code handoff allowing a desktop planning session to be continued on a handheld smartphone PWA without app store barriers.

5. Constraints & Factors Considered

  • Zero-bandwidth environments (offline caching).
  • Power and slope limits of planetary mobility chassis.
  • Strict scientific provenance: every waypoint cites its exact NASA PDS data volume.
